results.title: COP31 activists urge leaders to act on climate crisis
results.content: Speaking at a news conference on the sidelines of the talks, Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg warned that the world is heading towards more genocides, ecocides and the loss of basic rights.

results.title: UN food agency chief calls for end to Sudan war as famine crisis deepens
results.content: The UN says around 34 million people — nearly two-thirds of Sudan’s population — need humanitarian assistance. It has also warned that drone attacks by both sides have killed civilians, including children, and disrupted essential services.

results.title: US: New Congress members pose for traditional photo at Capitol
results.content: Newly elected US lawmakers gathered on Capitol Hill on Thursday 12 November for a traditional group photograph ahead of the opening of the 120th Congress. The incoming House members are attending orientation following the November midterm elections.

results.title: The Gambia's electoral commission announces 5 candidates for presidential poll
results.content: The Gambia’s electoral commission has confirmed five candidates for next month’s presidential election. They include incumbent Adama Barrow who is running for a third term despite initially promising not to do so. It’s not clear whether more candidates are still to be named.

results.title: 47th edition of Cairo International Film Festival gets underway in shadow of war
results.content: The 47th Cairo International Film Festival got underway on Wednesday in the Egyptian capital. The event brings together filmmakers, actors and other prominent figures from around the world. This year’s festival is taking place under the shadow of the Middle East war.

results.title: 'Nothing will stop us,' Nigerian opposition leader vows after campaign event attack
results.content: Violence broke out in Lagos on Thursday as members of the opposition Nigeria Democratic Congress gathered for a town hall meeting. Participants were forced to flee as suspected protesters armed with sticks, machetes and axes tried to force themselves into the event.

results.title: Ghana announces first-ever hydrocarbon discovery in carbonate reserve
results.content: Ghana's President John Dramani Mahama on Wednesday announced the country's first-ever hydrocarbon discovery in an offshore carbonate reserve. The well lies some 150 kilometers off Ghana's coast in water more than 2000 meters deep.

results.title: War in Ukraine: Putin Meets with envoys from the U.S. President
results.content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders on Thursday against discussions between the United States and Russia

results.title: Gaza: Devastation inside Nasser Hospital after deadly Israeli strike
results.content: An Israeli airstrike hit Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, early on Thursday 12 November, killing six people, including a doctor, and injuring at least 27 others, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

results.title: ANC vows "soul searching" after election losses but says Ramaphosa will stay put
results.content: Days after a drubbing at the ballot box, the leaders of South Africa's ruling African National Congress met to discuss the way forward. In last week's local elections, the party's vote share dropped by 15 points to just 31 percent.

results.title: UN weighs peacekeeping cuts in Central African Republic as mandate expires
results.content: The UN Security Council is set to decide on the renewal of MINUSCA’s mandate, which expires this weekend.

results.title: Russia: Soldier killed in car explosion in Saint Petersburg
results.content: A Russian serviceman was killed when his car exploded in Saint Petersburg on Thursday. Investigators have opened a murder inquiry, while local media report that another person was injured.

results.title: Mississippi elects first Black US Senator since post-Civil War Reconstruction
results.content: The US state of Mississippi has made history - electing its first Black Senator in 150 years and its first Democratic Senator since 1982. Forty-three-year-old Scott Colom narrowly beat incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith marking a seismic shift for the conservative southern state.

results.title: Ukraine: Russian drone attack sparks major fire in Kyiv residential building
results.content: A Russian drone strike sparked a major fire at an apartment building in Kyiv, Ukraine, early on Thursday. Residents fled to safety as firefighters battled the flames and rescue workers helped people at the scene.

results.title: Ghana unveils new cedi banknotes celebrating national heritage
results.content: Ghana has unveiled a new series of banknotes featuring prominent historical figures and national landmarks, as the country moves to modernise its currency and strengthen protection against counterfeiting.

results.title: Trial of more than 1,200 people accused of illegal gold mining opens in Conakry
results.content: The trial of more than 1,200 people charged with illegal gold mining opened in Conakry on Wednesday amid a recent crackdown on the practice. results.title: Slovenia: Red Bull human catapult sets two Guinness World Records
results.content: Two BASE jumpers made history in Trbovlje, Slovenia, after being launched into the sky from a 360-metre industrial chimney using what organisers describe as the world's largest human catapult.

results.title: Pin trading craze brings athletes together at Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics
results.content: At the Dakar Youth Olympic Games, small pins have become prized keepsakes, traded by athletes, volunteers and collectors across the train, press centre, Olympic Village and stadium.

results.title: Teenager arrested over killing of Ghanaian boy in New York
results.content: A teenager was arrested Wednesday in the fatal shooting of a 15-year-old Ghanaian immigrant on his way to school, New York City police said as the victim’s family, Ghana’s government and civil rights advocates pressed for justice.

results.title: Africa: Investment projects rise amid lower FDI [Business Africa]
results.content: Foreign direct investment (FDI) flows into Africa reached approximately $70 billion in 2025, down from $94 billion in 2024, marking a decline of nearly 26%.

results.title: South Sudan and UN failed to heed massacre warnings-Amnesty International
results.content: South Sudan and UN peacekeepers are being accused of failing to act on warnings of a massacre that killed more than 200 people in March.

results.title: Women and children bear the brunt of Ethiopia border violence
results.content: Ethiopians fleeing conflict in their home country have found shelter in the Kenyan border town of Moyale.

results.title: Peru: Pope Leo XIV returns to his adopted homeland on historic visit
results.content: Pope Leo XIV received a rapturous welcome in Peru, on 11 November, where he spent more than two decades as a missionary and bishop. Greeted by President Keiko Fujimori, he described his return as a homecoming.

results.title: US: Survivor pulled alive from rubble after deadly Brooklyn collapse
results.content: At least two people have died and 17 others were injured after a three-storey building partially collapsed in Brooklyn, shortly after 4 pm on Wednesday, 11 November. Rescuers pulled four survivors from the rubble as firefighters continued searching for people feared trapped beneath the wreckage.

results.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak surpasses 11,000 cases as conflict hampers response
results.content: The Democratic Republic of Congo's worst-ever outbreak of Ebola has now reached more than 11,000 confirmed cases, official Congolese figures showed on Wednesday, as armed conflict hampers the response.

results.title: DRC opposition vows to resist constitutional changes under Tshisekedi
results.content: The Democratic Republic of Congo’s opposition has condemned a new law enacted by President Félix Tshisekedi, accusing him of paving the way for a third term in office.

results.title: Spain: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after peaceful general strike march
results.content: Burning barricades and clashes with riot police erupted in Barcelona after a peaceful march against soaring housing costs. Police used projectiles to disperse masked protesters as violence spread through the city centre.

results.title: Spain: 120,000 brave rain to demand affordable housing and better wages
results.content: Around 120,000 demonstrators marched through central Madrid on Wednesday 11 November, according to authorities, as Spain's first nationwide general strike since 2012 brought crowds onto the streets to protest against soaring housing costs and mounting pressure on household budgets.

results.title: Uganda’s ruling party rejects Museveni’s reported plan to position son as successor
results.content: A succession battle is emerging within Uganda’s ruling party, after senior officials rejected President Yoweri Museveni’s reported plan to position his son as his successor.
